title: nierembergia angustifolia var. frutescens
intro: Nierembergia angustifolia var. frutescens, commonly known as Blue Pansy or Nierembergia, is a flowering plant belonging to the Solanaceae family. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include relief from anxiety and stress, as well as its potential to help improve sleep quality due to its calming effects. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic properties, which help to reduce muscle tension and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Nierembergia angustifolia var. frutescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
